user.description: Set up the Alerts Assistant hub. You can add individual alerts afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single Alerts Assistant hub is allowed.

data_description.state: The alert fires while the watched entity is in this state.
data_description.notifiers: Select one or more notify services or entities, or enter a target manually.
data_description.repeat: Minutes between notifications. Comma-separate to escalate, e.g. 15, 30, 60.
data_description.skip_first: Wait one interval before the first notification.
data_description.ack_from_notification: Add an Acknowledge button to mobile_app notifications (requires Can be acknowledged).
data_description.message: Optional template. Defaults to the alert name.
data_description.done_message: Optional template sent when the alert clears.
data_description.data: Optional key/values passed to the notify service (e.g. priority, channel).

error.invalid_repeat: Enter one or more positive numbers of minutes, comma-separated.
error.no_notifiers: Select at least one notification target.

turn_on.name: Reset (re-arm)
turn_on.description: Removes the acknowledgement so the alert notifies again while still firing.

turn_off.name: Acknowledge
turn_off.description: Acknowledges the alert, silencing further notifications until it clears.

toggle.name: Toggle acknowledgement
toggle.description: Toggles the acknowledged state of the alert.
